purpose: Executable ledger for the `matter-spectrum-coupling-mass` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Interaction-coupling rows separate gauge, Yukawa, Wilson, source/detector, waveform, cosmological, and benchmark couplings from observed-sector recovery and candidate identity.

interaction_coupling_rows.coupling_object: Gauge, Yukawa, Wilson-coefficient, source/detector, waveform, survey, dark-sector, benchmark, or dictionary coupling claimed by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
interaction_coupling_rows.gauge_yukawa_or_effective_coupling_rule: Name whether the coupling is gauge, Yukawa, Wilson/EFT, compactification-derived, RG-running, source/detector, map-likelihood, dark-sector, or metadata-only. Basis, normalization, and scheme choices remain explicit debts.
interaction_coupling_rows.texture_mixing_or_running_rule: Declare texture, mixing matrix, running law, matching rule, source-population prior, or benchmark feature map. CKM/PMNS, neutrino, threshold, and flavor-sector claims require route-local denominators rather than analogy.
interaction_coupling_rows.hierarchy_or_tuning_risk: Failure appears when a coupling fit depends on post-hoc texture choice, vacuum/compactification selection, prior volume, scheme choice, benchmark leakage, or parameterization rather than a route-native prediction.
interaction_coupling_rows.public_record_or_fit_gap: A coupling row may carry fit/constraint credit but cannot recover the matter sector or promote a candidate without public records, contrast class, prior sensitivity, measurement, matching, and mass/hierarchy rows.
interaction_coupling_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer interaction unification, flavor solution, coupling prediction, or candidate identity from a fitted, matched, or selected coupling object alone.
